name: Claude Computer Use Demo
description: Anthropic's reference implementation that lets Claude operate a sandboxed Linux desktop inside a Docker container.
whatItDoes: Users give Claude a task in a Streamlit chat and watch it use the mouse, keyboard, shell and file editor on a virtual desktop. It is the official starting point for building computer-use agents.
howItWorks: The container bundles a virtual display, desktop apps and an agent loop that sends screenshots to Claude and executes the computer, bash and text-editor tool calls it returns. It supports the Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex.

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Anthropic API key; Bedrock or Vertex credentials are alternatives

models: Claude via Anthropic API, Bedrock or Vertex
